## Endorsements
:::

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
#day21 is endorsed and supported by the following organisations:

<br> <br>

The College of Sexual & Reproductive Healthcare

[COSRH.org/](https://www.cosrh.org/)

<a href="https://www.cosrh.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> <img src="images/cosrh_logo_without_writing_white.png" alt="The College of Sexual and Reproductive Healthcare" style="width:80%; display:block; margin:0 auto;"/> </a>

<br> <br>

Dr Alison Wright, President of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, said: 

"Far too many women face difficulties and delays in accessing contraception, including after giving birth. These barriers have real and lasting consequences for women's health, autonomy and future care needs. 
#Day21 is an important campaign working to ensure women get the right contraception support after pregnancy, so they can make fully informed choices about their reproductive health."

<br>
